COMMIT EVIDENCE:
Preserve Forever companion history when realm names are unavailable

diff --git a/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md b/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md

--- a/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md
+++ b/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md
@@ -154,4 +154,6 @@ Location rendering examines up to 512 candidates per surface and renders at most
 **Retail versus Forever:** regional full identities are retained for communication, ignore checks, comparisons, player menus, dots and plates. Existing Forever First-Surname profile storage keys are preserved, but missing-name fallbacks never invent a realm. Forever does not read or display realms or War Mode. Other clients require a readable `C_PvP.IsWarModeFeatureEnabled()` result before sampling/displaying War Mode; the native Active value is used rather than Desired. Unknown metadata stays unknown. Coordinate-based announcement proximity checks War Mode only when supported and otherwise retains map/distance checks; unreadable capability cannot establish proximity. Map dots are never filtered by phase or War Mode. Geometric floor checks remain necessary for accurate map projection.
 
+**Blank realm names on Forever:** profile assignments, personal bubble anchors, player notes, roster/transport identities and Battle.net contact discovery use regional character identity without requiring `GetRealmName()`. Recent Companions also uses the existing client/region/naming-model namespace on Forever. Its former internal-realm buckets are merged locally, retaining the newest valid observation for each full name and the existing 100-entry/90-day limits. Migrated buckets are retired so removing or clearing history cannot resurrect them after reload. Ordinary clients retain their realm separation and reject an empty realm rather than create an ambiguous history bucket. No realm is reconstructed from a GUID. Blank-realm behavior and legacy-history migration have offline regression coverage; live confirmation on the updated client remains separate.
+
 The installed Forever API exports contain no verified four-way Normal/PvP/RolePlay/Hardcore getter/enum. `UnitGetAvailableRoles` means tank/healer/damage; `C_GameRules.IsHardcoreActive` is only a boolean. No role label is inferred from either API or a realm name. Supporting those tooltip labels needs a verified native contract. A compatibility review receipt and source evidence are recorded under `.local/reviews/client-paradigm-2026-09-28/` and `.local/reviews/forever-paradigm-2026-09-28/`; tests remain private/addon-owned and native contract mocks remain offline.
 

END UNTRUSTED SOURCE

@@ -61,4 +46,58 @@ local function Rows(addon, store, now)
 end
 
+-- Forever identities are regional, not tied to the internal realm/shard.
+-- Merge the old realm buckets once per store and retain the newest observation.
+local function MigrateRegionalHistory(addon, stores, namespace)
+	if not addon:UsesRegionalPlayerNames() then return end
+	if rawget(addon, "recentCompanionMigrationStore") == stores
+		and rawget(addon, "recentCompanionMigrationNamespace") == namespace then return end
+	local now = Now(addon)
+	if not now then return end
+	local keys, merged = {}, {}
+	local prefix = namespace .. ":"
+	for key in pairs(stores) do
+		if type(key) == "string" and key:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then keys[#keys + 1] = key end
+	end
+	table.sort(keys)
+	-- Prefer the current bucket on equal timestamps. Sorted legacy keys make
+	-- ties independent of Lua's table iteration order.
+	table.insert(keys, 1, namespace)
+	for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
+		local source = stores[key]
+		if type(source) == "table" then
+			for name, record in pairs(source) do
+				local identity = addon:GetPlayerNoteIdentity(name)
+				local stamp = type(record) == "table" and addon:SafeToNumber(record.lastGrouped)
+				if identity and stamp and stamp > 0 and stamp <= now + 300 and now - stamp <= RETENTION
+					and (not merged[identity] or stamp > merged[identity].lastGrouped) then
+					merged[identity] = { lastGrouped = stamp, classFile = Class(addon, record.classFile) }
+				end
+			end
+		end
+	end
+	Rows(addon, merged, now)
+	stores[namespace] = merged
+	for index = 2, #keys do stores[keys[index]] = nil end
+	addon.recentCompanionMigrationStore, addon.recentCompanionMigrationNamespace = stores, namespace
+end
+
+local function Store(addon, create)
+	local db = rawget(addon, "db")
+	local global = db and db.global
+	if type(global) ~= "table" then return nil end
+	local namespace = Namespace(addon)
+	if not namespace then return nil end
+	if type(global.recentCompanions) ~= "table" then
+		if not create then return nil end
+		global.recentCompanions = {}
+	end
+	MigrateRegionalHistory(addon, global.recentCompanions, namespace)
+	if type(global.recentCompanions[namespace]) ~= "table" then
+		if not create then return nil end
+		global.recentCompanions[namespace] = {}
+	end
+	return global.recentCompanions[namespace]
+end
+
